newsitem.title: ITALY: Mondadori Q1 97 sales in line with budget.
newsitem.headline: Mondadori Q1 97 sales in line with budget.

text.p: Italy's largest publishing group Mondadori, controlled by Silvio Berlusconi's Fininvest SpA, posted first quarter 1997 group turnover of 501 billion lire, in line with budget forecasts, chairman Leonardo Mondadori said.
He was addressing the annual shareholders' meeting which voted to increase to nine from seven the members of the board.
In reply to a question, he said the group would remain for the time being without a managing director after the resignation of Paolo Forlin in February for personal reasons.
As already announced, Mondadori posted 1996 consolidated net profit of 56 billion lire, down from 68.5 billion in 1995.
